work.heading: Selected work
work.copy: These case studies represent only part of my range. My work spans product positioning, messaging, technical documentation, social and community strategy, creator partnerships, events, websites, multimedia production, campaign operations, and distribution. The examples below show how I move from strategy through execution and coordinate the people, systems, and details required to ship.

rail.heading: More of the work
rail.copy: Selected frames from documentation, website, event, and production work.

items.title: Positioning and messaging
items.copy: Translate stakeholder knowledge and technical product detail into positioning, messaging architecture, audience strategy, claims standards, and reusable copy systems.

items.title: Technical content
items.copy: Research and write technical documentation, articles, website copy, presentations, scripts, and social content pitched to different levels of product familiarity.

items.title: Creator and community programs
items.copy: Manage creator relationships, sponsor packages, contracts, logistics, content reviews, publishing schedules, and coordinated distribution across social communities.

items.title: Multimedia and events
items.copy: Develop concepts, scripts, shot lists, decks, and production plans, then work hands-on with cameras, lighting, audio, speakers, creators, editors, and event partners.

howIWork.heading: AI-accelerated. Governed by human judgment.
howIWork.lead: I use AI as operating infrastructure, not as a substitute for strategy. After interviewing company leaders and technical stakeholders, I translate their knowledge into positioning, messaging, claims, audience, and content systems that people and automated workflows can use consistently.
howIWork.supporting: I also build governed workflows for recurring intelligence, analytics, documentation maintenance, opportunity monitoring, and outreach. Every system works from approved brand and claims context, cites its sources, and stops for human review before an unverified fact reaches the public.

categories.title: Marketing intelligence
categories.copy: Leadership interviews, competitive research, buyer analysis, product positioning, messaging hierarchies, claims logs, and reusable content systems.

categories.title: Governed automation
categories.copy: Recurring workflows monitor performance, identify opportunities, maintain prospect intelligence, and propose updates within defined verification and approval rules.

categories.title: Build and execution
categories.copy: AI-assisted websites, MDX documentation, dashboards, CRM systems, technical-content maintenance, creative production, and cross-channel distribution.

howIWork.accountability: AI accelerates the work. I remain accountable for source verification, brand voice, disclosure standards, cross-functional review, and final approval.

about.heading: Strategy without losing the execution
about.intro: I build the strategic foundation, then stay with the work until it ships.
paragraphs: I joined Phi Labs Global to manage social media for Archway, a Layer 1 blockchain. Four months later, the company sunset the protocol and shifted its focus to Bolt Liquidity, a next-generation prop AMM. As the organization evolved, my remit expanded far beyond social: I took ownership across positioning, content, community, technical documentation, creator partnerships, events, and production.

That experience shaped how I work today. I can build the strategic foundation, translate a technical product, manage external relationships, and step directly into production or distribution when the work needs to ship. Before Web3, I spent more than a decade building audiences and managing the business behind a globally distributed independent music project.
